correctness.rationale: Exact matrix-unit test fixes every nonzero support arrow. An odd-length two-cycle evaluation forces equal relative phases; scalar phase multiplication is exactly invisible because \(\zeta^n=1\). All cases and the even boundary are proved symbolically, with exhaustive small cases rerun.
